history.head: Payments received
history.unavailable: History unavailable: neither the history service nor the network answered. Invoice states still come from the network.
history.noneRecent: No payment on the network in the last {duration}.
history.sourceIndexer: From the PayLink history service (Envio), which can lag. Each receipt is checked on the network when opened.
history.sourceChain: From the network's latest blocks only: the history service is not available.
history.settle.one: Time to get paid: {duration} (one invoice from this device)
history.settle.other: Typical time to get paid: {duration} (median of {count} invoices from this device)
history.status.noChain: Answers, but serves none of this edition's networks.
